In Tamil Nadu and across Indian government health/NHM tenders, MTM (Mobile Team / Medical ) vehicle hiring conditions generally require a white sedan/car under 4 years old and under 1,0 0,000 km, hired at around ₹30,000 per month inclusive of fuel, driver, and maintenance Vehicle Eligibility & Condition · Vehicle Type & Colour: White sedans/cars such as Swift Dzire, Indica, Indigo, Maruti Suzuki Tou r, Hyundai X-cent, or Hyundai Aura (depending on the specific tender). · Age & Mileage Cap: Less than 4 years old from the registration date and ≤ 1,00,000 km. If th e vehicle hits 1,00,000 km during the contract, a replacement must be provided at no extra cost. · Equipment & Branding: GPS tracking device fitted/active, MTM/program display stickers affixe d, and used exclusively for MTM duties. · Required Documents: Valid Registration Certificate (RC), comprehensive insurance, commercia l permit, Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate, and driver license (plus vendor/owner KYC/UDYA M documents as specified in the tender). · Operating & Commercial Terms · Monthly Rate & Usage: Commonly ₹30,000/month with a 2,000 km monthly ceiling, coveri ng fuel, driver wages/statutory benefits (such as EPF), and routine maintenance. · Logbook & Parking: Daily trip logbooks must be maintained and signed by the designated Medi cal Officer, with parking at the assigned PHC/Block/health facility. · Breakdowns & Absenteeism: The vendor must arrange a substitute vehicle and driver immedi ately during breakdowns or driver leave. · Driver Rules: Valid commercial driving license, neat/white uniform or dress code as required, an d strict zero tolerance for alcohol/intoxicants (with blacklisting penalties for violations). .
